name: browse_library
description:
Browse the ChatCut Library with one unified discovery tool.

This tool is for ChatCut Library content only, not the user's project assets/media pool and not timelines. Categories match the Library tabs: motion-graphics, luts, zoom, effects, audio-effects, sound-effects, transitions.

Built-in entries in this runtime:
- effects: Rectangle Mask, Circle Mask, Local Mosaic, …
- luts: Sony S-Log3 s709, Canon Log3 to Canon 709
- transitions: Anticipation Zoom, Clean Line Wipe, Cross Dissolve, Dip to Black, …
- zoom: Slow Push, Slow Pull, Instant, Quick In, …

Supported modes:
- No filters: returns a whole-Library overview with category counts.
- category: returns one Library tab's group overview with counts.
- category + group: returns a small list of items in that group.
- query: returns a small matching item list, optionally scoped by category.
- id: returns one item's details plus Desktop Memory usage guidance.
- limit + offset: paginates list results.

List results contain id, name, category, and description. Detailed usage guidance is returned only by id mode. On Desktop, timeline mutations use MemoryModel fields directly:
- motion-graphics: call manage_template apply with the template UUID from the selected item's usage guidance.
- zoom: add a pixel-effect with assetId:"builtin:effect-zoom" and the selected preset's propertyOverrides.
- luts and effects: add a pixel-effect with targetItemId, or trackId + startFrame + durationFrames.
- visual transitions: add a pixel-transition between adjacent items.
- sound-effects: call edit_item adds:[{type:"audio",assetId:"library:sound:<id>",fromFrame:<editorial anchor frame>}]. The source is imported locally and reused by content. The item starts early enough for its sound anchor to land on fromFrame, clamped to frame zero while retaining the full source audio.
- audio transitions: discovery is available, but the current Desktop Memory edit_item cannot apply these Library entries.
- audio-effects: currently has no available Library entries; an empty result is expected.

category.description: Optional Library tab/category filter: motion-graphics, luts, zoom, effects, audio-effects, sound-effects, or transitions.

group.description: Optional Library group id filter. With category, returns list results from that group.

id.description: Exact Library item id to inspect after search. Returns the chosen item plus usage guidance from this same tool.

limit.description: Maximum list results to return. Defaults to 10, max 30.

offset.description: List offset for pagination in list mode.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over id, name, category, group, description, and keywords. Supports multi-word queries and common quote/social/card/sound-effect synonyms. Passing query returns a list.
